name: Paramount 3D
summary: Bensenville, Illinois (US) supplier selling filament alongside PCB prototyping boards, copper-clad laminates and FR-4. It claims to have been founded in 1994. The range covers PLA (matte and silk), PETG, ABS, ASA, flexible, PVA, nylon and CF-filled PA6, PETG and ABS, much of it in named military-style colours. The origin of the filament is not stated.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: 1.75 mm 1 kg; many named colours. Also sold on 'masterspools' (refills).

product_lines.name: FlexPLA / TPU
product_lines.notes: Flexible line; whether 'FlexPLA' is a TPU or a flexible PLA blend is not documented.

additional_notes: Address 754 Birginal Dr, Bensenville, IL 60106; phone (630) 594-1840, email team@paramount-usa.com. The site shows (c)2016 while claiming the company was founded in 1994. Not the 3D Systems-owned Paramount Industries. Manufacturing origin is not disclosed, and the '100% virgin' claims are marketing, so oem_relationships is empty. Sold on its own site plus Amazon and third parties. Price tier unverified, so omitted. SpoolmanDB PR #413 lists 12 entries.

provenance.conflicts: Identity and location are medium confidence; manufacturing origin is low/unknown. Legal entity name not stated on the site.
